macros.name: ifSubfilesClassLoaded
macros.doc: The command \ifSubfilesClassLoaded is useful to execute commands conditionally, depending on whether the main file is typeset or a subfile.

macros.name: subfileinclude
macros.doc: The command \subfileinclude specifies the command \subincludefrom for \includeing the subfile, and then calls \subfiles@subfile.
